name: routines_propose
description: Saves a proposal for a new routine: a task the assistant would run on its own on a schedule. It is a draft and does nothing until the user approves it; it never creates a trigger and never changes an existing routine. Use it only when the user asks for something recurring, or agrees after you suggest it, and after routines_list shows no routine with the same purpose. If the schedule or the task is not clear, ask; do not guess. Returns the proposal id and how the user approves it: tell them it is NOT active until they do.

name.description: Short name for the routine: lowercase letters, digits and -, starting with a letter (e.g. morning-issues).

every.description: How often it runs: a number and m, h or d, at least the user's minimum interval (e.g. 1d).

task.description: What each run does, in plain words, as the user said it (e.g. Summarise the open issues of PROJ every morning).

budget.description: Spend cap per run in US dollars, never above the user's limit shown by routines_list (e.g. 0.25).

why.description: One line telling the user why it helps, shown with the proposal (e.g. You ask for this every morning).

examples.name: morning-issues
examples.task: Summarise the open issues of PROJ every morning
examples.why: You ask for this every morning

examples.name: inbox-digest
examples.task: List the unread emails that need a reply, with a one-line summary each
